requirements.note: Inset-grouped list of 420 episodes, newest first. Each row shows show, title, date · length and a Played/Unplayed line.
A real UISwitch 'Unplayed only' filters the list (295 → 294 after a change, and played rows drop out live). The show screen has the same switch.
Shows tab lists 12 shows with 'N episodes · M unplayed' and a chevron. Tapping one pushes that show's episodes.
Detail shows show, title, date, length, summary and Play. Play marks the episode played, turns into Stop and shows a 'Playing' waveform label. There are also mark-played and Up Next rows.
Each row has a circle/checkmark toggle button that flips played state in place. There are no swipe actions on the episode list.

A '+' on each row (it becomes a grey disabled check once queued) and a detail row add to Up Next. Edit mode reorders with Up/Down buttons and removes with Remove buttons. Swipe-to-delete also works outside Edit.
After relaunch, played state, queue order and removals were all kept.

bugs: No functional bugs found. All spec features worked in testing.
tells: Every episode row has a 188pt-wide column for two stacked icon buttons (circle toggle, '+'). The text is squeezed into ~138pt, so short titles like 'A history of beekeeping' wrap at default size and the right side of each row is mostly empty.
At the largest text size the narrow text column breaks words and numbers mid-way: 'be / e- / kee / p- / ing', 'The / Long / Field', and the date split across lines as '26 / 202…'.
Up Next reordering uses 'Up' / 'Down' text buttons in each row instead of the system drag-reorder handles in an editing table.
No swipe actions on episode rows for played/unplayed or queueing; it relies on always-visible buttons.
The Up Next tab icon is a plain hamburger (line.3.horizontal), which reads as 'menu' rather than a queue.
On the detail screen the title of a played episode turns grey, so the main title looks disabled.
Plain system-default look: no artwork anywhere. It is correct but bare, like a settings form rather than a podcast app.
A.scroll: The 420-row list scrolls smoothly with momentum and rubber-banding, and the inline title fades in under a blurred bar. No blank rows or jumps, and scroll position was kept after pushing a detail and coming back. Rows are tall (126pt), so the list is long.

requirements.note: Newest-first list of 420 episodes with show artwork, an uppercase show name, title, 'date · length', and a played/unplayed dot or check with label. A sticky 'LATEST EPISODES 420' header stays pinned while scrolling.
A segmented control 'All episodes / Unplayed' filters the list, and the count updates (420 → 295). At the largest text size it becomes a pull-down menu. The show screen has the same control.

Shows tab lists 12 shows with artwork, tagline and 'N episodes · M unplayed'. Tapping one pushes a show page with artwork, a filter and its episodes. The show page header shows only the episode count, not the unplayed count.
Detail has large artwork, show, title, full date, a clock with length, played status, summary and a prominent Play button. Play marks the episode played, becomes Pause and shows 'Playing'.
From the list: trailing swipe 'Mark played' (full-swipe works), leading swipe 'Add to Up Next' / 'Remove from Up Next', and a '…' menu with Mark as played/unplayed and the queue action.

Adding works from swipe, the menu and detail, and an 'Up Next' badge appears on queued rows. Edit mode has real drag handles and drag-reorder worked. In Edit mode, though, the red '−' button reveals 'Mark played' instead of Delete, so you cannot remove from there. Removing works through a leading swipe or the '…' menu.
After relaunch, played state, the reordered queue and removals were all kept.

bugs: Up Next Edit mode: the hint says 'Tap − to remove', but tapping the red minus reveals a 'Mark played' action rather than Delete, so the system remove gesture in Edit mode does not remove the item.
On Up Next a trailing (right-to-left) swipe marks the episode played instead of removing it. Removal is only on the leading swipe, so a full trailing swipe there accidentally marks episodes played.
tells: Custom marketing-style hero cards ('STAY CURIOUS / Your next great listen.', 'A good listen, lined up.') above the lists look more like a web landing page than a stock iOS list.
There are two ways into search on the main screen: a circular toolbar search button and a search field that appears when you pull down.
Rows have both a disclosure chevron and a '…' button side by side, which is redundant.
Inside Up Next every row still carries an 'Up Next' badge, which adds nothing there.
The Up Next Edit 'Done' button is drawn as a filled green checkmark circle rather than a 'Done' text button.
B.scroll: The long list scrolls smoothly with momentum, rubber-banding and a pinned section header under the blurred large-title bar. No blank or popping rows, and the position was kept after returning from a detail.

why: Both apps cover every requirement and persist state. B looks and behaves like a real iPhone podcast app: artwork, a segmented filter, swipe actions, context menus, drag-to-reorder, and text that adapts cleanly at the largest size. A works but has an awkward squeezed row layout, Up/Down buttons instead of drag reorder, no swipe actions, and words and dates broken mid-way at large text. B's Edit-mode minus not deleting is a real flaw, but a smaller one overall.
